title: The underlying sheaf of sets of a directed colimit of sheaves of modules is the colimit of the underlying sheaves of sets
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $\mathcal O_X$ a sheaf of rings on $X$ and $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ the category of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $I$ be a directed set and $(\mathcal F_i,\varphi_{i'i})_{i\le i'}$ a system of $\mathcal O_X$-modules over $I$ with a colimit $(\mathcal F,(c_i)_i)$ in $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then the underlying sheaf of sets of $\mathcal F$, with the maps of sheaves of sets underlying the $c_i$, is a colimit of the system of underlying sheaves of sets of the $\mathcal F_i$ in the category of sheaves of sets on $X$.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01AH (lemma-limits-colimits, line 204), part (2): colimits in Mod(O_X) are the sheafification of the presheaf colimit; with Sheaves, Lemma 007O (lemma-properties-algebraic-structures, item (7): a filtered colimit of modules has as underlying set the colimit of the underlying sets), Sheaves, Lemma 0087 (lemma-sheafify-presheaf-structures (1): the underlying sheaf of sets of the sheafification of a presheaf of algebraic structures is the sheafification of the underlying presheaf of sets) and Section 009E (section-limits-sheaves, item (3)). Stacks uses this silently when applying Sheaves 009F (sheaves of sets) to O_X-modules in the proof of Modules 01BS.

proof.text: Apply CategoryTheory.moduleSheaves_colimits_forgetful to O and I. Its preservation clause says that toSheaf O preserves I-colimits, so the given module colimit has underlying abelian sheaf the colimit of the abelian-sheaf diagram H = F ⋙ toSheaf O. This keeps the existing Modules 01AH/03DB/03CY tool, without constructing another presheaf of modules.

Let J be the opens topology, U the forgetful functor from abelian groups to sets, L the abelian presheaf sheafification functor, S = sheafCompose J U, and G = H ⋙ sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat. The category I is filtered since it is a nonempty directed preorder. The forgetful instance in the cited Mathlib leaf and the pointwise whiskeringRight preservation instance show that forgetting G to a diagram of set presheaves preserves its colimit.

Sheafification of set presheaves preserves colimits by its left-adjoint universal property. The canonical sheafComposeNatIso J U, which commutes abelian sheafification with forgetting to sets, identifies whiskeringRight U followed by set sheafification with L ⋙ S. Thus L ⋙ S preserves the colimit of G. This uses the abelian-to-sets comparison part of the module-sheafification underlying-sets Mathlib leaf.

The counit of the abelian sheafification adjunction is an isomorphism, giving e : G ⋙ L ≅ H. For hG = colimit.isColimit G, the mapped cocone L.mapCocone hG.cocone is colimiting, and its image under S is colimiting because L ⋙ S preserves hG. The lemma preservesColimit_of_preserves_colimit_cocone therefore shows that S preserves the colimit of G ⋙ L; preservesColimit_of_iso_diagram transports this along e to H. Composing with step 1 and applying isColimitOfPreserves to the supplied witness proves the required universal property with exactly the mapped coprojections.
